# Process-level tests (cmd/blockvolume, build tags subprocess and
# chunkstore_integration, linux) named as release evidence. CI runs them
# against real blockmaster, blockvolume and sw-block binaries and the pinned
# SeaweedFS release. Every name here must PASS: a skip, a failure or a test
# that never ran fails the job (.github/scripts/required-tests-check.py).
#
# Not here, and why: the three headroom tests (TestHeadroom*), the power-loss
# replay (TestPowerLossReplayChunkVolume, a dm-log-writes harness) and the
# tests tagged systemd_integration need root, a loop or mapped device, or
# systemd; the CI runners have none of these. They run as root outside CI,
# and their counts are recorded there.

# Known-zero acceptance, small shape in CI (KZ_RUN=1 KZ_SIZE=1G, user-space
# client, no device); the 1 TiB run is lab only.
TestKnownZeroAcceptance
TestKnownZeroTargetReservesBeforeHarness

# The procedure gate, delete and master loss.
TestProcedurePlannedHandoffToAnotherHost
TestProcedureSameHostRestartInsideTheLease
TestProcedureSameHostCrashRestartInsideTheLease
TestProcedureReturnAfterALapsedLease
TestProcedureForcedMoveWithTheOldHostReturning
TestProcedureRevokeWithoutACKThenForcedMove
TestProcedureStartInsideTheBarrierWaitIsReGranted
TestProcedureDeleteAVolume
TestProcedureDeleteAfterASignalStop
TestProcedureMasterKilledAfterMoveBeforeTargetStarts
TestProcedureMasterUnreachableFencesBeforeForcedMove
TestStandalonePlannedHandoffToTheSameHost
TestStandaloneCleanMoveWithoutTheACKIsRefused

# Failover and the fencing round.
TestDoubleFailoverReadsBackEveryAckedWrite
TestFencingRoundHealContinuesThePrimary
TestFencingRoundSurvivorRejoins
TestAVolumeThatServedBeforeItsFirstGateTickFailsOver

# Many volumes on one host (F1_RUN=1).
TestSnapshotLadderF1VolumesOneHost

# Never-started delete.
TestNeverAttachedRestoreTargetIsDeletable
TestNeverStartedDeleteFencesALateStart
TestNeverStartedDeleteRacesAStart
TestNeverStartedLineIsDeletableWithoutARevoke
TestNeverStartedLineDeleteFencesALateStart
TestNeverStartedLineDeleteRacesAStart
TestNeverStartedDeleteAfterAMasterRestart
TestClaimedTargetAfterAMasterRestartIsNotNeverStarted

# Snapshot ladders and cutover.
TestSnapshotLadderA1OneBlockOneSnapshot
TestSnapshotLadderA2IncrementalSnapshot
TestSnapshotLadderA3WritesDuringASnapshot
TestSnapshotLadderA4ContentReturnsToAnOldValue
TestSnapshotLadderB1SnapshotQuery
TestSnapshotLadderC1FullRestore
TestSnapshotLadderC2IncrementalRestore
TestSnapshotLadderC3RestoreThenWriteThenSnapshotIt
TestSnapshotLadderC3KilledHydrating
TestSnapshotLadderD1DeleteTheNewest
TestSnapshotLadderD2DeleteAMiddleOne
TestSnapshotLadderD3DeleteWhenContentRecurs
TestSnapshotLadderD4DeleteAllButOneThenCollect
TestSnapshotLadderE1CrashDuringASnapshot
TestCutoverCreateFromSnapshot
TestCutoverWriteSnapshotKillRestartRestore
